_comment: Every Flash model the provider publishes, with its rate. A price reference, not a routing decision.
config.stable.json says which model a feature calls. This file says what a model costs, including
models no chain names. It exists because fallbackPrice is a guess: a cost report that meets a model
it has no rate for falls back to it and reads plausibly while being wrong, on a report a customer
pays to read. A consumer that prices usage should fetch both and look here when config has no entry.
purposes carries default and nothing else, and default is a copy of what config.stable.json already
routes to. Nothing should route from this file. The field is here because the format requires it,
and copying today's answer is the only value that cannot change anyone's behaviour by accident.
Same three rules as the routing catalogue: version only goes up, undo by publishing higher, and
nothing customer-specific, because this is public too.
notes: Re-read priceSource on 2026-09-23. Standard Flash rates unchanged. Corrected image and live text rates that had been copied from 3.8 Flash. Added gemini-3.8-live and gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking. 2.5 Flash and Flash-Lite are ga with limited access, not deprecated. 3.1 Flash Live Preview is deprecated in favour of 3.8 Live.

models._vision_comment: vision is a claim that the model can be handed an image, and build.mjs checks it wherever a chain reads one. Matching catalogue.src.json for every model that file also names. Lineup-only models stay false unless the model page lists Image as an input.

gemini-3.8-flash._comment: Gemini 3.8 Flash · Latest Flagship. Through 31 Dec 2026: 0.75 / 0.075 / 3.75. From 1 Jan 2027: 1.5 / 0.15 / 7.5.

gemini-3.6-flash._comment: Gemini 3.6 Flash · GA. Doubles on 1 January 2027, along with 3.8 and 3.7 flash: input 1.5, cached 0.15, output 7.5.

gemini-2.5-flash._comment: Gemini 2.5 Flash · still served. The models page says it is not deprecated; access is limited to users who have used it before. input here is text/image/video; audio is 1.00.

gemini-3.1-flash-lite._comment: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite · GA. input here is text/image/video; audio is 0.50.

gemini-2.5-flash-lite._comment: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite · still served, access limited to prior users, not deprecated. input here is text/image/video; audio is 0.30.

models._embedding_comment: Not a Flash model, and not in the list this file was built from. It is here because config.stable.json routes kb-embed-index and kb-embed-query to it, and a lineup that cannot price something the router can reach has failed at the one job it has. The rate is the one already published in config.stable.json, and verify.mjs fails if the two ever stop matching.

gemini-embedding-001._comment: Embeddings bill input only. dim is part of the model's identity: stored vectors were written at this size and cosine against a different size is meaningless, not merely worse.

models._specialized_comment: Image, image-lite and live. Their rates are quoted per million tokens like the rest, which is the only reason they fit this file at all — a model billed per image or per second of audio would need a price shape this schema does not have. Check the quoted unit before trusting a total. input and output here are the text numbers; the page also quotes audio and image-output rates that this shape cannot carry.

gemini-3.1-flash-image._comment: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (Nano Banana 2) · GA. Text/image input 0.50, text output 3. Image output is 60 per 1M tokens. No context cache on the page, so cachedInput equals input.

gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image._comment: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image (Nano Banana 2 Lite) · GA. Text/image/video input 0.25, text output 1.50. Image output is 30 per 1M tokens. No context cache on the page, so cachedInput equals input.

gemini-3.8-live._comment: Gemini 3.8 Live · GA. Default Live API. Standard text 0.75 in / 4.50 out; audio is 3.00 in / 12.00 out. No context cache on the page, so cachedInput equals input.

gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking._comment: Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking · GA. Same Standard table as gemini-3.8-live.

gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview._comment: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live · Preview, now the legacy Live API. Same Standard table as 3.8 Live. Provider recommends gemini-3.8-live. No shutdown date announced.

purposes._comment: A copy of what config.stable.json routes by default, and nothing more. Route from config, not from here.
